notes:
- Feature: new group **Experimental (Demo only)** in the Strategy list with three strategies ported from the strategy lab (tools/research/strategies/), the best near-misses of the research run. None passed all research checks; they are there to be forward tested on the Demo account. All use 1 min candles and a 5 min expiry, no news pause (the backtests had none), no strategy risk preset.
  - Rollover fade (research r1-3-sessfade): PUT 16:50 to 16:59 New York time, CALL 17:00 to 17:34 and 17:55 to 18:09 New York time (US daylight saving rules, from the candle's UTC time), otherwise a fade of a 10 min move of at least 2.75 times its EMA(50) size. Backtest 57.95% train, 58.50% validation, 57.87% unseen data (holdout) at about 4.3 signals per hour per pair, 9 of 10 pairs above 55.56% on validation. Rejected by the verifiers: the edge is the vendor's bid quote dipping at the rollover; mid prices 51.27%, ask 44.88%.
  - Candle score fade (research r1-4-microscore): fixed train-fitted score of 17 candle shape features, CALL at +0.1232, PUT at -0.1232. 53.54% train, 54.41% validation, holdout not run, about 4.0 signals per hour per pair, 3 of 10 pairs.
  - Stretch fade (research r2-6-trendfade, final variant): stretch S of the 1, 5 and 30 min moves in units of their EMA(50) size, PUT at S >= 2.5, CALL at S <= -2.5, no signal 20:00 to 22:59 UTC. 53.05% train, 54.05% validation, holdout not run, about 4.1 signals per hour per pair, 2 of 10 pairs.
- Each port runs the research code's own update / signal steps over the closed candles the bot holds (up to 500), so it gives the same signal from the same candles. tests/experimental-equivalence.test.js checks every signal against the research harness on 3 days of real EUR/USD (January) and USD/JPY (July) 1 min candles and on a EUR/USD weekend with stream holes (tests/fixtures/), including the 500-candle live window.
- Warm-up: 300 candles for Rollover fade and Stretch fade, 150 for Candle score fade (research: 80, 120, 4000), so the indicator state has settled: tests/experimental-windows.test.js checks that every window from the warm-up to 499 candles gives the same signal as the 500-candle window. Quotex sends about 200 candles of history, so those two wait about 100 more minutes after a page load or pair change.
